```{r setup}
library(tidyverse)
library(gt)

# Load Survey export CSV
# Replace filename with your local path if necessary
df_raw <- read_csv("results.csv")

```




```{r process-data}
# Tidy survey responses and calculate consensus metrics

# 1. Identify outcome/indicator columns dynamically
outcome_cols <- names(df_raw)[
  str_detect(names(df_raw), "^outcome_scores\\[") | 
  str_detect(names(df_raw), "^Rate the relative importance")
]

# 2. Reshape and clean responses
df_long <- df_raw %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = all_of(outcome_cols),
    names_to = "indicator_raw",
    values_to = "score_raw"
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(score_raw)) %>%
  mutate(
    # Extract numeric score whether value is "A6", "6", or numeric 6
    score = as.numeric(str_extract(as.character(score_raw), "\\d+")),
    
    # Map column headers or codes to clean indicator names
    indicator = case_when(
      str_detect(indicator_raw, "SQ001|Outcome A") ~ "Primary Health Indicator / Outcome A",
      str_detect(indicator_raw, "SQ002|Metric B")  ~ "Secondary Health Indicator / Metric B",
      str_detect(indicator_raw, "SQ003|Metric C")  ~ "Patient-Reported / Experience Metric C",
      str_detect(indicator_raw, "SQ004|Metric D")  ~ "Resource Utilization / System Metric D",
      TRUE ~ indicator_raw
    ),
    
    # Categorize into standard GRADE tiers
    tier = case_when(
      score >= 7 ~ "Critical (7-9)",
      score >= 4 ~ "Important (4-6)",
      score >= 1 ~ "Limited (1-3)"
    )
  )

# Summary table per indicator
summary_tbl <- df_long %>%
  group_by(indicator) %>%
  summarise(
    N = n(),
    Mean = mean(score, na.rm = TRUE),
    Median = median(score, na.rm = TRUE),
    IQR = IQR(score, na.rm = TRUE),
    Pct_Critical = mean(score >= 7, na.rm = TRUE) * 100,
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(Mean))
```


# Summary Metrics Table

```{r summary_table}
#| echo: false
summary_tbl %>%
  gt() %>%
  tab_header(
    title = "GRADE Outcome Prioritization Summary",
    subtitle = "Mean, median, and proportion rated critical (7-9)"
  ) %>%
  fmt_number(columns = c(Mean, Median, IQR), decimals = 2) %>%
  fmt_number(columns = Pct_Critical, decimals = 1, pattern = "{x}%") %>%
  cols_label(
    indicator = "Outcome Indicator",
    Pct_Critical = "% Critical (7-9)"
  )
```

## Rating distributions per indicator


```{r viz-rating}
# Rating distributions per indicator
ggplot(df_long, aes(x = factor(score), fill = indicator)) +
  geom_bar(show.legend = FALSE) +
  facet_wrap(~ indicator, ncol = 2) +
  scale_x_discrete(drop = FALSE, limits = as.character(1:9)) +
  scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Set2") +
  labs(
    title = "Distribution of Scores Across 1-9 GRADE Scale",
    x = "Score (1-3: Limited | 4-6: Important | 7-9: Critical)",
    y = "Count"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()


```

## Median rankings across outcomes

```{r viz-ranking}
# Median rankings across outcomes
ggplot(df_long, aes(x = reorder(indicator, score, FUN = median), y = score, fill = indicator)) +
  geom_boxplot(alpha = 0.7, show.legend = FALSE) +
  geom_jitter(width = 0.15, alpha = 0.5) +
  annotate("rect", xmin = -Inf, xmax = Inf, ymin = 7, ymax = 9, alpha = 0.1, fill = "red") +
  annotate("rect", xmin = -Inf, xmax = Inf, ymin = 4, ymax = 6, alpha = 0.1, fill = "blue") +
  annotate("rect", xmin = -Inf, xmax = Inf, ymin = 1, ymax = 3, alpha = 0.1, fill = "gray") +
  coord_flip() +
  scale_y_continuous(breaks = 1:9, limits = c(1, 9)) +
  labs(
    title = "Outcome Rankings & Quartiles",
    x = NULL,
    y = "Importance Score"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```
